Henry A. Crumpton

H C
Henry A. Crumpton is the chairman of Crumpton Global LLC, a global business advisory firm. He is also a partner at Crumpton Ventures, a private equity firm that invests in companies serving U.S. and allied interests. After a 24-year career in the CIA’s Clandestine Service, he served as the US coordinator for counterterrorism with the rank of Ambassador at Large. He lives in the Austin, TX area.
